about: Corrections the bake applies where OpenStreetMap's tags leave a fact out (PLAN §5). Each names what it changes and why; the bake report lists every street it closes.

closeToBuses.name: Storrow Drive
closeToBuses.why: A DCR parkway closed to buses and trucks; most of it is tagged hgv=no or with clearances under 3.5 m, and this catches any piece that is not.

closeToBuses.name: Memorial Drive
closeToBuses.why: A DCR parkway closed to buses and trucks; OSM tags only some of its ways (1.4 km of it in the fixture carried no restriction on 2026-10-13).
